Energy, Utilities, Environment, and Climate Committee
Monday, March 4, 2024
12:30 PM, 1150 Minnesota Senate Bldg.

Minutes

Present: Senator Nick A. Frentz - Chair, Senator Tou Xiong Vice Chair, Senator D. Scott Dibble, Senator Steve Green,
Senator Glenn H. Gruenhagen, Senator John A. Hoffman, Senator Matt D. Klein, Senator Eric Lucero, Senator Andrew Mathews,
Senator Jennifer A. McEwen, Senator Nicole Mitchell, Senator Lindsey Port, Senator Jason Rarick, Senator Bill Weber

Absent: No Members Absent

Senator Nick A. Frentz called the meeting to order at 12:34pm

Call to Order

S.F. 3949: Senator McEwen: High-voltage transmission lines siting and relocation provisions modifications.

Senator McEwen offers the A1 amendment
Motion passes unanimously via voice vote

Senator Mathews offers the A4 amendment
Motion failed via voice vote

Senator Xiong moved that S.F. 3949, as amended, recommended to pass and re-referred to the Transportation Committee. -
MOTION PREVAILED.

The meeting was adjourned at 1:21pm

Senator Nick A. Frentz, Chair Travis Urness, Legislative Assistant
